Method of Attack: Modular malware with backdoor controlling other components and connecting to remote server
Payload components targeting industrial control communication protocols IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC DA
Relays commands to switches and circuit breakers to cause network outages and physical damage
Secondary backdoor, port scanner, data wiper module to delay responders and destroy target computer
Impacted Systems: Electricity substation switches and circuit breakers
Indicators of Compromise: Use of four payload components targeting IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC DA protocols
